_readme: ONE table of database shapes -> expected open-time verdict, read by BOTH
agent/tests/schema-version.test.js and api/tests/test_schema_version.py.
agent/src/adapters/persistence/schema-version.js and api/schema_version.py
are separate implementations of the same three verdicts over the same
api/schema.sql. They happen to agree today; nothing was enforcing that,
which is exactly how the redaction rule in the sibling pair (db-path.js /
db_path.py) drifted for four review rounds. This fixture is the
enforcement. Add a shape here, not to one suite.
Each case: apply setup_sql to a fresh temp database (empty means a brand
new file); if pre_migrate, run check_and_migrate once first; if
user_version is not null, stamp it; then run check_and_migrate and match
expect{}.
expect.verdict       'created' | 'current' | 'migrated' | 'incompatible'
('incompatible' means it must RAISE/THROW).
expect.message_matches   regexes the refusal message must match. Written
in the subset of syntax that means the same thing in
both JS RegExp and Python re.
expect.user_version_after   PRAGMA user_version once the dust settles.
expect.columns_absent / columns_exactly   PRAGMA table_info assertions.
Result-shape keys differ by runtime (JS `skippedIndexes` vs Python
`skipped_indexes`); each suite maps its own naming.

_why: Finding 6: an incomplete migration refuses on every subsequent open, by
design. The message said to 'rebuild the database' and named no command, so
an operator hitting it at 3am had a database that refuses forever and no
There is no single supported rebuild command in this repo: scripts/seed.py is
a stub, api/db.py::init(reset=True) has no CLI entry point, and
agent/scripts/seed-medications.js only materialises rows. What is true, and
what the message names, is that check_and_migrate takes its 'created' branch
on an absent or empty file and runs api/schema.sql whole.
shared_matches   wording both runtimes must carry.
per_runtime      the start command differs, so each suite asserts its own.
forbidden        the primary instruction must never be destructive. A refused
database may be the only copy of a medication schedule, and
no refusal modified its rows: refusing is recoverable,
label_is_redacted  the message names a configured path, and a configured path
has been a connection string carrying a password more than
once here. It goes through the same redactor as finding 1.
